summary: Iteration 19 - Testing new features: Indian Food Calorie Tracker (Glydex & Evara), User Preferences API, Admin Analytics Dashboard, Admin 2-row tab layout. All 21 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working.
test_type: New Features Testing - Calorie Tracker, User Preferences, Admin Analytics

tests.name: Homepage loads with Nevika Cura branding
Glydex page shows Login Required for unauthenticated users
Evara page loads with all programs (Pregnancy, Menopause, Period, PCOS, PMS)
Evara Calorie Tracker button visible and clickable
Evara Calorie Tracker dialog opens with Indian food database
Admin login works with password nevikacura2026
Admin Dashboard shows 8 tabs in 2 rows of 4
Admin Analytics tab shows revenue and appointment charts

indian_food_calorie_tracker.details: Indian Food Calorie Tracker implemented in both Glydex and Evara modules. Database contains 100+ Indian foods across categories: Breakfast, Lunch/Dinner, Snacks, Beverages, Sweets/Desserts, Diabetic Friendly. API endpoints: GET /api/calories/food-database, GET /api/calories/search, POST /api/calories/log, GET /api/calories/logs, DELETE /api/calories/logs/{id}, GET /api/calories/daily-summary

calorie_tracker_glydex.details: Calorie Tracker button visible in Glydex dashboard (requires login). Button has data-testid='calorie-tracker-btn'. Opens dialog with food search, category browsing, and daily log.

calorie_tracker_evara.details: Calorie Tracker button visible in Evara page. Dialog shows Indian Food Calorie Tracker with Today's Summary, Search, Browse by Category, Food Log, and Tip for Women.

user_preferences_api.details: User preferences/interests API working. PUT /api/user/preferences updates interests and onboarding_complete. GET /api/user/preferences returns user's interests. Requires authentication.

profile_customization.details: Profile customization step implemented in Auth Modal after registration. Users can select interests from: Evara, Glydex, DiaGyn Healthcare, Proton Diagnostics, Orange Pharmacy. Step shows after email verification and registration.

admin_analytics_dashboard.details: Admin Analytics tab shows dashboard with: Total Revenue, Total Appointments, Total Diagnostics, Total Pharmacy Orders. Charts display data for configurable time period (7/30 days). API: GET /api/admin/analytics?days=7

admin_tab_layout.details: Admin tabs organized in 2 rows of 4 for better aesthetics. Row 1: Pharmacy, Tests, Tracking, Loyalty. Row 2: Leave, Staff, Orders, Analytics. Uses grid-cols-4 layout.

mocked_data.indian_food_database: HARDCODED in server.py - 100+ Indian foods with calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber values
mocked_data.educational_content: Evara educational content (Pregnancy, Menopause, Community) is hardcoded in Evara.js

User preferences API properly secured with authentication
Admin Analytics dashboard provides useful business insights

Evara Calorie Tracker accessible without login for browsing
